# Basic — Defects

Unformalized claims gathered verbatim from [wiphy.org](https://wiphy.org/) (query: “defect CFT holography”).

claims.name: cone_holography_obtained_zerovolume_limit
claims.statement: Cone holography can be obtained as the zero-volume limit of holographic defect CFT.

claims.name: braid_group_representations_defect_operators
claims.statement: Braid group representations, defect operators, and holography are connected within the AdS/CFT framework.

sources.title: Braid Group Representations and Defect Operators in AdS/CFT Correspondence

claims.name: ads_defect_cft_correspondence_provides
claims.statement: AdS/defect CFT correspondence provides a framework that joins holography, integrability, supersymmetric localization, and the conformal bootstrap program for defects in real-world systems.

claims.name: text_ads_text_cft_holography
claims.statement: In $\text{AdS}_3/\text{CFT}_2$ holography with $U(1)$ Chern-Simons theory, a $U(1)$ Wilson line defect anchored at entangling region endpoints generates Aharonov-Bohm flux and determines symmetry-resolved entanglement entropy.

sources.title: Symmetry-Resolved Entanglement in AdS${}_3$/CFT${}_2$ coupled to $U(1)$ Chern-Simons Theory

claims.name: double_holography_entanglement_entropy_defect
claims.statement: In double holography, the entanglement entropy of a defect subregion on the boundary of a CFT$_3$ is determined from the brane perspective by the quantum extremal surface anchored at the two endpoints of the subregion.

sources.title: Entanglement of defect subregions in double holography

claims.name: dual_mathcal_cft_side_paper
claims.statement: From the dual $\mathcal{W}_{(3|2)}$ CFT side, the paper computes the full quantum BPS bounds and matches their semiclassical limit to extremal black hole or conical defect solutions in the 3d bulk, tying the higher-spin extremality analysis to holography.

claims.name: paper_finds_defectsubregion_quantum_extremal
claims.statement: The paper finds that defect-subregion quantum extremal surfaces in double holography have two distinct phases and undergo an entanglement phase transition controlled by the brane degrees of freedom. A semi-ellipse shrinking procedure numerically separates a shrinking phase, where the defect entanglement wedge collapses to zero as the CFT$_3$ is removed, from a stable phase where the wedge remains nearly constant.

sources.title: Entanglement of defect subregions in double holography

claims.name: paper_constructs_family_dualities_between
claims.statement: The paper constructs a family of dualities between certain non-supersymmetric self-dual gauge theories on 4d self-dual asymptotically flat backgrounds and the large-$N$ limit of an independently defined 2d chiral defect CFT via twisted holography for the type I topological string on a Calabi-Yau five-fold fibred over twistor space. Within this duality, single-trace defect-CFT operators are put in bijection with celestial chiral algebra states, and their operator products reproduce self-dual gauge-theory collinear splitting amplitudes up to one loop.

sources.title: Self-Dual Gauge Theory from the Top Down
